input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 auto-renews each Order Form for twelve months (acceptable term length) but conditions non-renewal on 180 days' advance notice. That exceeds both the preferred 30-day and fallback 60-day opt-out windows and falls into walk-away territory (windows longer than 90 days). We therefore shortened the window to 30 days, matching the preferred position and approved precedent. Pricing is not an issue: § 8.3 caps renewal uplifts at the lesser of CPI and 3%, requires 90 days' notice, and exempts prepaid periods, which meets the preferred cap and is favourable to us. The absence of a Vendor renewal reminder 60 days before renewal is a minor gap from the preferred wording only and is noted rather than flagged.

ops.oldText: unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice
ops.newText: unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice before the end of the then-current term

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from 180 days to 30 days before the end of the then-current term; our playbook allows automatic twelve-month renewals only where we can opt out on 30 days' notice (60 days at the outside), and a 180-day window is not workable for us. The twelve-month renewal term and the CPI/3% uplift cap in 8.3 work as drafted.
proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window from 180 days to 30 days
